notes.title: Update 0.22.0
notes.notes:
⚔️ Gameplay
New enemy: Copytron — It mimics your movements with a slight delay.

Reworked Super Coins — There can now be several per run, but each one gives fewer coins than before.

Improved power-up handling — Better feedback and more consistent interactions between different power-ups.

Updated "Larger Ball (Super)" power-up — Now deals 1 extra damage while keeping the same size as the regular version.
🎨 Visuals
Added CRT shader — Can be toggled on or off in the settings.
⚙️ Other Improvements
Several objective names have been updated for better clarity.

New settings added: frame rate limiter and VSync toggle.

Leaderboard reset to reflect the new balance changes.
🐛 Fixes
Super Coins now only count once in the statistics.

Settings now load correctly when launching the game.

Enemies no longer become invincible after 8+ minutes in a single run.
🎵 Audio
New music track: "Knocked Out"

notes.title: Patch 0.21.3
notes.notes:
Fix for "Dasher" Objective: The "Dasher" objective now increments correctly.
Fix for Challenges Display: Challenges now display correctly on the death screen.
Fix for "Ball Damage" Upgrade: The upgrade that enhances ball damage now functions properly and once again kills basic enemies.

notes.title: Patch 0.21.2
notes.notes:
Save System
To enhance the gaming experience, Reflectron now uses the Steam cloud to save your data, except for the leaderboards. Unfortunately, your previous data will be lost, except for your best score. Here is a list of the benefits offered by this new save system:


Almost complete offline mode support (except for leaderboards), including the ability to purchase cosmetics without an Internet connection.
Faster and more stable game loading.
Saves directly linked to your Steam account.
Fewer Internet requests, improving the gaming experience.

notes.title: Patch 0.21.0
notes.notes:
Gameplay

Slow-motion power-ups: The slow-motion effect now also slows down the appearance of enemies, projectiles and splitter-generated enemies.
Power-ups: The first power-up obtained in a game is now randomly selected, while the order of subsequent power-ups remains unchanged.
Upgrades: Upgrades are now unlocked according to the number of enemies killed, rather than over time.

Visual

Loading particles: Removed particles around the power-up when it transforms into a super power-up.
XP bar and feedback: Added an XP bar and visual feedback when enemies die to better track your progress.
Upgrade interface: Color changes for better readability and aesthetics.

Other improvements

Upgrade selection: Upgrades can now be selected via keyboard or joystick.
Language support: Added support for the French language.

Other improvements

Upgrade selection: Now possible to select upgrades via keyboard or joystick.
Language support: Added support for the French language.

Corrections

Statistics: Corrected counting of total number of enemies killed and total number of games played for greater accuracy.
Leaderboards: Improved data transmission to backend for leaderboard updates.
Huge enemy hitboxes: Corrected hitboxes for size 3 enemies, particularly when using a 2-damage bullet.

Audio

Interface sounds: Added new sound effects when selecting upgrades and modified existing sounds for greater immersion.
Hover sound: Introduction of a sound effect when hovering over buttons for more intuitive interaction.


We hope these updates will enhance your gaming experience, and look forward to seeing how you perform with these new features! Enjoy your game on Reflectron!
